description: The score-card validator accepts numeric period start_at/end_at values because scoreAsDate passes arbitrary values to Date; a malformed non-ISO model is rendered as four cards instead of failing the score section closed.

evidence.snippet: function scoreAsDate(value) { const date = new Date(value); return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date; }
evidence.testName: malformed-model probe: numeric periods 0/1000 produced acceptedMalformedNumericPeriods=true and cardCount=4
